# Jacques M. Jean

> Personal site of Jacques M. Jean — Haitian-born American founder, technologist, and global operator based in Frisco, Texas. CEO & Founder of TechFides (AI that small businesses own, installed on their own hardware) and Founder & Chair of Levoila (a citizen-led global heritage trust). He spent 25 years building enterprise technology for Honeywell, Invensys, and Schneider Electric across more than 30 countries, and works in 5 languages: English, French, Haitian Creole, Spanish, and Portuguese.

## Who he is

- Born in Ferrier, Nord-Est, Haiti; came to the United States as a teenager.
- 25 years in enterprise technology leadership: Honeywell, Invensys, Schneider Electric — systems delivered in 30+ countries.
- Education: MS in Public Policy & Management, Carnegie Mellon University; BS in Economics, Universidad de Guadalajara; executive education at Harvard Business School and UNC Kenan-Flagler.
- Credentials: Six Sigma Black Belt, PMP, ITIL. Forbes Technology Council member. Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Businesses fellow.
- Walked into a library for the first time at age 18 — then built 3 public libraries in northern Haiti (Pilate, Ferrier, Ouanaminthe) serving a region of more than 500,000 people.

## What he does now

- [TechFides](https://techfides.com): CEO & Founder. Installs AI on hardware businesses own — medical offices, law firms, auto dealers, property managers, trades. Customer data never leaves the building; one-time setup from $5,000 with a flat monthly retainer instead of climbing cloud bills. Hardware-agnostic (Mac, Windows, Raspberry Pi, servers) and AI-agnostic (Claude, Llama, Mistral, ChatGPT — or the public AI stack a client prefers).
- [Levoila](https://levoila.org): Founder & Chair. A global heritage trust where citizens nominate at-risk sites, stewards vote on what to save, and every dollar is traceable on a public ledger. Phase One restores three sites in Haiti — the Citadelle Henri Christophe, Palais Sans-Souci, and Fort Liberté — with 75–85% local hiring.
- Governance: Board Chair, OVYNA. Co-Chair (Founding), American Business Council Gabon — building U.S.–Gabon commercial bridges. Board Chair, MUSA Asset Management.

## How to reach him

Three doors: a 20-minute TechFides discovery call for business AI; Levoila stewardship for heritage work; direct email for board service, speaking, advisory, and press. He reads every message and replies within 1–2 days.
